question: Should OpenClaw add a read-only depth/recursive mode to `subagents list`, and should that API live on the existing subagents tool now or wait for broader session-chain/tree surfaces?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the fix defines public tool and slash-command semantics around nested agent hierarchy visibility and control boundaries.

options.title: Add read-only depth listing
options.body: Add `depth`/`recursive` as additive read-only list options with parent/depth metadata while leaving direct-child control actions unchanged.

options.title: Route through chain/tree work
options.body: Keep this issue open but make the recursive view depend on the broader session-chain or active-agent tree design before adding a new API shape.

options.title: Decline hierarchy expansion
options.body: Document the existing direct-child list, `sessions_history`, and completion-event workflow instead of exposing depth-0 inspection of depth-2 workers.

recommendation.title: Add read-only depth listing
recommendation.body: Add `depth`/`recursive` as additive read-only list options with parent/depth metadata while leaving direct-child control actions unchanged.
